name: ACME_evacuated
writer: Mission author or Zeus script on the patient
reason: Optional evacuation flag consumed by TBI recovery; no automatic evacuation event is defined by this addon.

name: ACME_vehicleOpen
writer: Mission author or vehicle compatibility script on the vehicle
reason: Optional numeric openness override in the range 0 to 1. Unset values use the existing animation-source inference.

name: ACME_facialBurn
writer: Mission author or Zeus scenario script on the patient
reason: Retained additive scenario hook. Native head burn wounds are also detected without this flag. Full heal clears the hook.

name: ACME_leftAlign_managedButton
writer: Legacy v0.9.437 compositor, only in a surviving old dialog
reason: Historical cleanup only. Current code never activates this obsolete overlay flag; retain cleanup for an old display.

name: ACME_leftAlign_originalText
writer: Legacy v0.9.437 compositor, only in a surviving old dialog
reason: Historical cleanup only. Current native renderer does not blank button labels or produce saved label text.

name: ACME_CS_FingerLift
writer: Optional local mission/UI integration; no producer in the shipped addon
reason: Optional cosmetic finger offset override. Default remains dot height times 1.6. Does not gate treatment or presence transmission.

name: ACME_IV_PadTex
writer: Optional local mission/UI integration; no producer in the shipped addon
reason: Optional cosmetic held-pad texture override. Retain shipped texture default; no gameplay state depends on an external writer.
